MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID, JAKARTA – Badan Pengelola Keuangan Haji (BPKH) menargetkan transformasi kelembagaan menjadi pengelola dana haji yang terpercaya dan berkelas dunia (trusted and world class) pada 2027. Target tersebut menjadi bagian dari upaya memperkuat tata kelola, meningkatkan kepercayaan publik, serta mengoptimalkan nilai manfaat dana haji bagi jemaah Indonesia.

Kepala Badan Pelaksana BPKH, Fadlul Imansyah, menjelaskan bahwa transformasi tersebut ditempuh melalui tiga strategi utama. Ketiganya meliputi perluasan peran kelembagaan, penguatan kapasitas dan kontribusi dalam ekosistem haji, serta diversifikasi investasi yang terukur.

Hal tersebut disampaikan Fadlul dalam rapat kerja bersama Komisi VIII DPR RI di Jakarta, Senin (16/11).

Menurutnya, perluasan peran kelembagaan harus berjalan seiring dengan penguatan kepercayaan publik dan penerapan tata kelola yang baik. Sementara itu, peningkatan kapasitas kelembagaan diarahkan untuk memperkuat posisi strategis BPKH dalam ekosistem penyelenggaraan ibadah haji.

Adapun strategi diversifikasi investasi dilakukan melalui pengembangan berbagai instrumen investasi, termasuk investasi langsung. Langkah ini diharapkan dapat meningkatkan nilai manfaat sekaligus menjaga keberlanjutan dana haji dalam jangka panjang.

Di samping memaparkan arah transformasi kelembagaan, Fadlul juga menyampaikan perkembangan kinerja keuangan BPKH hingga 31 Oktober 2026. Berdasarkan laporan tidak terkonsolidasi, total aset BPKH tercatat mencapai Rp195,7 triliun atau meningkat 7,7 persen dibandingkan periode yang sama tahun sebelumnya.

Sementara itu, dana kelolaan mencapai Rp188,5 triliun dengan pertumbuhan 6,9 persen secara tahunan. Nilai manfaat tercatat sebesar Rp10,1 triliun, sedangkan surplus komprehensif mencapai Rp600 miliar atau meningkat 4,9 persen secara tahunan.

Dari sisi penempatan dan investasi, sekitar 80 persen dana atau setara Rp150,3 triliun dialokasikan pada instrumen investasi. Adapun 20 persen lainnya atau Rp38,3 triliun ditempatkan pada instrumen penempatan.

Berdasarkan pengelompokan dana kelolaan, Dana Penyelenggaraan Ibadah Haji (PIH) mendominasi dengan porsi 98 persen atau Rp184,6 triliun. Sementara itu, Dana Abadi Umat (DAU) tercatat sebesar Rp3,9 triliun atau sekitar dua persen dari total dana kelolaan.

Dari aspek kesehatan keuangan, rasio likuiditas wajib BPKH hingga akhir Oktober 2026 tercatat sebesar 2,21 kali, dengan perhitungan yang turut memperhitungkan uang muka.

Fadlul menegaskan bahwa penguatan kelembagaan dan pengembangan strategi investasi merupakan bagian penting dari upaya menjaga pengelolaan dana haji secara berkelanjutan. Dengan demikian, BPKH diharapkan mampu meningkatkan nilai manfaat sekaligus menjaga amanah dana yang dipercayakan oleh jemaah haji Indonesia.

Transformasi menuju pengelola dana haji berkelas dunia pada 2027 diharapkan tidak hanya memperkuat posisi kelembagaan BPKH, tetapi juga memastikan pengelolaan dana haji berlangsung secara profesional, transparan, dan memberikan manfaat optimal bagi umat.

Menuju 2027, BPKH Siapkan Transformasi Pengelolaan Dana Haji Berstandar Dunia

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID YOGYAKARTA –Kehadiran kecerdasan buatan yang dirancang khusus untuk kemudahan dalam mengakses rujukan keagamaan, ChatHPT, merekam angka yang tinggi dalam dua belas hari sejak pertama peluncurannya pada 5-16 November 2026.

Hal itu dipaparkan Wakil Ketua Majelis Pustaka dan Informatika (MPI) Pimpinan Pusat (PP) Muhammadiyah Ismail Fahmi, yang merumuskan laporan analisis ChatHPT bertajuk “Dari Munas ke Tanwir” yang disusunnya bersama tim Majelis Tarjih dan Tajdid (MTT) PP Muhammadiyah, tim MPI PP Muhammadiyah, dan tim LabMu.

Pada rentang waktu dua pekan, ChatHPT diserbu 129.657 pertanyaan dari 41.081 warga. Angka ini tidak lepas dari dua momentum besar persyarikatan yang membingkai perjalanan awal peluncurannya, yaitu Musyawarah Nasional (Munas) Tarjih XXXIII di Surabaya dan Sidang Tanwir dan Milad ke-114 Muhammadiyah di Palu.

Ismail mencontohkannya pada hari pertama Munas Tarjih XXXIII di Universitas Muhammadiyah Surabaya (Umsu). Menurutnya, sejak pertama kali diperkenalkan secara resmi, ChatHPT langsung mencetak rekor tertinggi harian dengan 26.790 pertanyaan hingga akhir dari penyelenggaraan Munas Tarjih menyumbang 68.256 pertanyaan keseluruhan.

Hal tersebut menggambarkan antusiasme masyarakat luas terhadap ChatHPT, sebab langsung terlihat begitu peluncuran diumumkan, misalnya pada pukul 22.30 WIB di malam pertama peluncurannya, kata Ismail, layar pemantau server mencatat rekor luar biasa: 1.137 pertanyaan masuk hanya dalam waktu lima menit yang setara dengan hampir empat pertanyaan per detik.

“Jumlah itu setara sepertiga seluruh pertanyaan selama 80 hari masa uji coba,” lanjut Ismail Fahmi.

Selanjutnya, Ismail menyebut sebagaimana siklus adopsi teknologi baru pada umumnya, euforia peluncuran sempat perlahan mereda. Volume harian sempat mengalami penurunan mencapai titik terendah di angka 4.565 pertanyaan pada Rabu (11/11). Namun, grafik penggunaan kembali berbalik arah ketika Sidang Tanwir Muhammadiyah 2026 dimulai di Palu, Sulawesi Tengah.

“Pola ini wajar untuk layanan baru, karena banyak orang mencoba sekali dua kali lalu kembali ke kesibukan masing-masing,” ujar Ismail

Memasuki Kamis (12/11), volume harian melonjak 45% menjadi 6.611 pertanyaan, dan kembali mencapai puncaknya di angka 6.684 pertanyaan pada Jumat (13/11) bertepatan dengan pembukaan pameran dan sidang pleno.

Rata-rata penggunaan selama Tanwir tercatat berada di kisaran 6.206 pertanyaan per hari. Menariknya, sehari setelah Tanwir ditutup pada Senin (16/11), volume masih bertahan di angka 6.424 pertanyaan yang menandakan bahwa agenda persyarikatan nasional tersebut tidak hanya memberikan lonjakan sesaat, namun melahirkan level dasar penggunaan baru yang jauh lebih tinggi dibandingkan masa uji coba beta sebelumnya.

“Namun ini baru data satu hari, sehingga belum bisa disebut signifikan secara statistik. Kami perlu memantau beberapa minggu kedepan untuk memastikan leve dasar yang baru ini benar-benar bertahan,” pungkas Ismail. (alam)

Dari Munas Tarjih hingga Tanwir, ChatHPT Raup 129 Ribu Pertanyaan dalam 12 Hari

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID YOGYAKARTA – Di balik angka ratusan ribu pertanyaan yang masuk ke sistem ChatHPT, laporan data analitik Wakil Ketua Majelis Pustaka dan Informatika (MPI) Pimpinan Pusat (PP) Muhammadiyah, Ismail Fahmi menunjukkan selama dua belas hari peluncurannya mengungkapkan pola perilaku digital yang menarik dari pengguna ChatHPT dalam mengakses bimbingan keagamaan.

Ismail mendapati waktu penggunaan ChatHPT oleh pengguna sangat erat dengan ritme ibadah dan aktivitas harian umat. Berdasarkan peta panas aktivitas sistem, volume pertanyaan mulai merangkak naik sejak terbitnya fajar, menguat pada sesi pagi pukul 09.00-11.59 WIB, lalu sedikit melandai pada siang hari.

Puncak kesibukan digital harian secara konsisten terjadi pada pukul 18.00-18.59 WIB atau menjelang Maghrib, yang menyumbang 7,0% dari total pertanyaan harian. Tidak kalah menarik, sekitar 8% dari total pertanyaan justru masuk pada rentang waktu Subuh yaitu pukul 04.00-06.59 WIB, yang selaras dengan tingginya volume pertanyaan praktis seputar tata cara shalat, wudhu, dan doa harian.

“Temuan paling menarik adalah ritme bertanya warga mengikuti ritme ibadah. Volume mulai naik sejak waktu Subuh, menguat pada pagi hari, sedikit melandai saat siang, lalu memuncak menjelang Maghrib,” ujar Ismail.

Lebih lanjut, laporan tersebut juga mencatat adanya fenomena unik di luar jam-jam konvensional. Tercatat ada lebih dari 5.000 pertanyaan yang masuk pada rentang tengah malam hingga pukul 04.00 WIB.

“Warga juga tetap bertanya pada jam istirahat. Lebih dari 5 ribu pertanyaan masuk antara tengah malam dan pukul 04.00. Pertanyaan mereka singkat dan langsung, rata-rata hanya tujuh kata,” sebutnya

Penggunaan ChatHPT, bagi Ismail, hadir dan bertransformasi menjadi ruang alternatif bagi masyarakat untuk mencari rujukan keagamaan ketika para ustaz atau pemuka agama setempat umumnya sudah beristirahat. Di samping itu, juga sekadar menggunakannya untuk menyiapkan khutbah, kultum, dan konten dakwah.

“Pada pagi hari ChatHPT membantu persoalan keseharian seperti muamalah, utang-piutang, dan transaksi digital. Pada malam hari, ChatHPT menjadi ruang bertanya untuk urusan keluarga yang seringkali terasa sensitif untuk ditanyakan kepada orang lain,” jelas Ismail.

Kendati demikian, tingginya interaksi digital ini tetap diiringi catatan penting dari para pengembang dan Majelis Tarjih agar umat tetap menjadikan teknologi ini sebagai pintu pembuka rujukan, serta senantiasa memverifikasi substansi hukum dan dalilnya kepada para ulama dan naskah resmi persyarikatan. “ChatHPT adalah pintu menuju khazanah tarjih, bukan pengganti ulama atau fatwa. Warga tetap dianjurkan membaca naskah tarjih yang dirujuk dalam setiap jawaban,” pungkas Ismail. (Alam)

ChatHPT Temani Keseharian Umat, Pertanyaan Agama Mengalir dari Subuh hingga Larut Malam

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID, JAKARTA — Ketua Pimpinan Pusat (PP) Muhammadiyah Kiai Saad Ibrahim menjelaskan makna beriman kepada perkara gaib sebagaimana disebutkan dalam Al-Qur’an surah Al-Baqarah ayat 3. Menurutnya, keimanan kepada yang gaib merupakan salah satu karakter utama orang bertakwa. Keimanan tersebut harus disertai pembenaran dan kesediaan menjalankan konsekuensi dari apa yang diyakini.

Hal itu disampaikan Kiai Saad dalam program Tausiah Kiai Saad TVMu yang tayang pada Sabtu (14/11). Dalam ceramahnya, ia mengawali pembahasan dengan mengutip surah Al-Baqarah ayat 3, alladzīna yu’minūna bil-ghaibi wa yuqīmūnash-shalāta wa mimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn, yang berarti orang-orang yang beriman kepada yang gaib, mendirikan salat, dan menginfakkan sebagian rezeki yang Allah berikan kepada mereka.

Ia menjelaskan bahwa ayat tersebut merupakan bagian dari uraian mengenai karakter orang-orang bertakwa (lil muttaqīn) yang disebutkan dalam ayat sebelumnya. Al-Qur’an menjadi petunjuk bagi orang bertakwa, yang salah satu cirinya adalah memiliki keimanan kepada perkara gaib.

Merujuk Tafsir al-Tabari, Kiai Saad menerangkan beberapa pengertian tentang perkara gaib. Makna pertama berkaitan dengan Al-Qur’an itu sendiri. Dalam pengertian ini, beriman kepada yang gaib dapat dimaknai sebagai kepercayaan kepada Al-Qur’an sebagai kitab petunjuk.

Kata yu’minūna, lanjutnya, juga memiliki makna yuṣaddiqūna, yakni membenarkan. Artinya, iman tidak berhenti pada pengakuan bahwa sesuatu itu benar, tetapi harus diikuti dengan pembenaran yang tercermin dalam tindakan.

“Orang yang percaya kepada Al-Qur’an tentu harus membaca, menelaah, mengambil pelajaran, kemudian menerapkannya dalam kehidupan,” jelasnya.

Menurut Kiai Saad, seseorang yang mengaku percaya kepada Al-Qur’an, tetapi mengabaikan konsekuensi dari kepercayaannya, belum menunjukkan hakikat keimanan secara utuh. Pembenaran terhadap Al-Qur’an menuntut kesediaan untuk mempelajari dan mengamalkan petunjuk yang terkandung di dalamnya.

Makna kedua dari perkara gaib berkaitan dengan rukun iman, terutama kepercayaan terhadap kehidupan akhirat. Dalam penjelasan ini, perkara gaib mencakup surga, neraka, dan seluruh hal yang berada di luar jangkauan pengetahuan manusia.

Kiai Saad mengingatkan bahwa kehidupan akhirat tidak dapat dipandang sebagai mitos atau sekadar gambaran yang diciptakan manusia untuk menghibur diri ketika tidak memperoleh keadilan di dunia. Pandangan yang menganggap surga dan neraka sebagai proyeksi psikologis manusia, menurutnya, bertentangan dengan ajaran Islam.

Ia menegaskan bahwa surga dan neraka merupakan kenyataan yang harus diyakini oleh orang beriman. Bahkan, keberadaan kehidupan akhirat dapat dijelaskan melalui pertimbangan rasional mengenai keadilan.

Menurutnya, kehidupan dunia memperlihatkan banyak kebaikan yang tidak memperoleh balasan setimpal. Sebaliknya, berbagai kejahatan juga tidak selalu mendapatkan hukuman yang semestinya. Jika kehidupan berakhir begitu saja setelah kematian, persoalan keadilan tersebut tidak memperoleh penyelesaian.

“Banyak kebaikan yang tidak terbalaskan dalam kehidupan dunia. Banyak juga kejahatan yang tidak mendapatkan hukuman. Maka, di situlah harus ada mahkamah pada hari kiamat,” paparnya.

Melalui pengadilan pada hari kiamat, Allah akan memperhitungkan seluruh amal manusia dan memberikan balasan atas kebaikan maupun keburukan yang telah dilakukan. Balasan di akhirat memiliki nilai yang jauh melampaui apa pun yang dapat diperoleh manusia selama hidup di dunia.

Selain pertimbangan keadilan, Kiai Saad juga mengajak umat Islam menyadari keterbatasan pengetahuan manusia. Menurutnya, keterbatasan itu bahkan terlihat ketika manusia berhadapan dengan sesuatu yang secara fisik dapat diamati.

Ia mencontohkan luasnya alam semesta yang belum mampu dijangkau seluruhnya oleh pengetahuan manusia. Bintang terdekat di luar tata surya, Proxima Centauri, misalnya, berjarak sekitar empat tahun cahaya dari bumi. Jarak tersebut menunjukkan betapa luasnya alam semesta dibandingkan kemampuan manusia untuk menjangkaunya.

Bahkan, sesuatu yang berada di sekitar manusia pun belum tentu dapat diketahui secara langsung melalui pancaindra. Atom, misalnya, merupakan bagian dari kenyataan alam yang keberadaannya diyakini meskipun tidak dapat dilihat dengan mata telanjang.

Dari kenyataan tersebut, Kiai Saad mengajak umat Islam memahami bahwa tidak semua yang ada dapat diketahui manusia. Karena itu, keterbatasan pengetahuan tidak dapat dijadikan alasan untuk menolak keberadaan sesuatu yang belum diketahui.

“Yang tidak diketahui tidak selalu berarti tidak ada,” tegasnya.

Ia menambahkan, manusia perlu menyadari adanya Zat Yang Maha Mengetahui, yakni Allah Swt. Betapapun luas dan mendalam pengetahuan yang berhasil dicapai manusia, semuanya tetap sangat kecil dibandingkan ilmu Allah yang meliputi segala sesuatu.

Bagi Kiai Saad, keyakinan kepada perkara gaib memiliki landasan keagamaan sekaligus dapat dipahami melalui pertimbangan rasional dan kenyataan empiris. Manusia perlu mengakui batas-batas pengetahuannya serta tidak menjadikan apa yang belum mampu dijangkau akal dan pancaindra sebagai sesuatu yang pasti tidak ada.

Mengapa Kehidupan Akhirat Harus Diyakini? Ini Penjelasan Kiai Saad Ibrahim

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID, PALU – Tanwir dan Milad ke-114 Muhammadiyah di Palu, Sulawesi Tengah, berlangsung lancar dengan suasana musyawarah yang sejuk, tertib, dan penuh persaudaraan.

Selama tiga hari, 13–15 November 2026, forum permusyawaratan tersebut tidak hanya menghasilkan sejumlah keputusan penting bagi persiapan Muktamar ke-49, tetapi juga memperlihatkan tradisi musyawarah Muhammadiyah yang sejuk, tertib, dan mengedepankan persaudaraan.

Kehadiran pimpinan Muhammadiyah dari berbagai wilayah, unsur organisasi otonom, majelis dan lembaga, serta pimpinan amal usaha menjadikan Tanwir sebagai ruang bertemunya beragam gagasan dan pandangan.

Sejumlah pimpinan yang telah lanjut usia tetap hadir mengikuti permusyawaratan dengan penuh semangat. Kehadiran mereka menjadi teladan tentang pengabdian yang tidak dibatasi usia, sekaligus menunjukkan bahwa menjaga dan membesarkan persyarikatan merupakan tanggung jawab bersama.

Suasana permusyawaratan yang demikian menjadi salah satu hal yang disoroti Ketua Umum Pimpinan Pusat (PP) Muhammadiyah, Haedar Nashir, dalam Pidato Iftitah pada Jumat (13/11) di Gedung Banua Kaili (GBK) H. Rusdy Toana, Universitas Muhammadiyah Palu.

Haedar mengungkapkan bahwa tradisi Muysyawarah di Muhammadiyah selama ini mendapat penghormatan dari berbagai kalangan. Bahkan, ia menyebut Nakamura pernah menggambarkan Muktamar Muhammadiyah sebagai “Muktamar Surga”. “Baik, damai, ada dinamika tetapi terkontrol, teratur,” ungkap Haedar menggambarkan tradisi permusyawaratan Muhammadiyah.

Menurutnya, dinamika dan perbedaan pandangan merupakan bagian wajar dalam kehidupan organisasi. Namun, semuanya perlu dikelola dengan kedewasaan, tanpa saling menjatuhkan dan mengorbankan persaudaraan.

Tanwir Palu memperlihatkan bahwa tradisi musyawarah Muhammadiyah bukan sekadar tentang merumuskan keputusan organisasi, melainkan juga tentang merawat kebersamaan, menghargai perbedaan, dan menjaga persaudaraan dalam setiap prosesnya.

Tradisi sejuk dan penuh persaudaraan ini diharapkan terus terpelihara begitupun saat Muktamar ke-49 Muhammadiyah di Medan pada 18–21 November 2027, sehingga dinamika organisasi senantiasa menjadi kekuatan untuk memajukan persyarikatan. (taufik)

Sejuknya Tanwir Muhammadiyah, Cermin Kedewasaan dalam Bermusyawarah

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID, YOGYAKARTA – Direktur Jamaica Muslim Center, Muhammad Syamsi Ali menyampaikan tahniah mubarak atas penyelenggaraan Tanwir dan Milad ke-114 Muhammadiyah yang berlangsung di Palu, Sulawesi Tengah, Jumat-Ahad (13-15/11/2026).

Dalam momentum tersebut, Syamsi Ali berharap pelaksanaan Sidang Tanwir Muhammadiyah dapat menghasilkan berbagai rumusan strategis yang nantinya menjadi bahan pembahasan dan pijakan dalam suksesnya Muktamar Muhammadiyah tahun 2027.

“Maka harapan kita Muhammadiyah, sebagai organisasi yang besar, dan hebat. Tidak saja memberikan kontribusi dalam pembangunan nasional bangsa Indonesia kita, tapi juga pembangunan yang mengglobal,” ucap Syamsi Ali yang juga merupakan kader Muhammadiyah dan kini tinggal di Amerika Serikat.

Ia berharap, berbagai gagasan dan keputusan yang dihasilkan melalui Tanwir dapat semakin memperkuat arah gerakan Muhammadiyah ke depan. Dengan demikian, Muhammadiyah tidak sekadar mampu menjaga keberlanjutan pengabdiannya tetapi juga memperluas kontribusi dan perannya dalam menjawab berbagai tantangan kemanusiaan untuk peradaban muslim global. (Bhisma)

Syamsi Ali Dorong Muhammadiyah Perkuat Peran Global melalui Hasil Tanwir

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID, YOGYAKARTA – Kiprah Muhammadiyah tidak hanya dikenal di tingkat nasional, tetapi juga telah menjangkau masyarakat muslim di berbagai belahan dunia. Selama 114 tahun perjalanan pengabdiannya, Muhammadiyah dinilai konsisten memperkenalkan dan mempromosikan nilai-nilai Islam, etika, serta prinsip-prinsipnya melalui berbagai gerakan dan proyek sosial yang dijalankan di sejumlah negara.

Hal tersebut disampaikan oleh Duta Besar Türkiye untuk Indonesia, Talip Küçükcan, melalui video ucapan Milad ke-114 Muhammadiyah yang diterima pada Jumat (13/11).

“Merupakan suatu kehormatan bagi saya untuk mengucapkan selamat kepada para tokoh, sekaligus seluruh anggota Persyarikatan Muhammadiyah atas jasa-jasa mereka dalam perjuangan Islam dan kontribusinya kepada masyarakat Indonesia selama lebih dari satu abad. Ketika kita melihat ajaran Muhammadiyah dan gerakan yang dijalankan para anggotanya, kita dapat melihat dengan jelas bahwa Muhammadiyah telah membawa perubahan besar dalam kehidupan bermasyarakat di Indonesia,” ucapnya.

Lebih lanjut, Talip menyoroti peran Muhammadiyah sebagai organisasi kemasyarakatan Islam yang tidak hanya berhasil mendidik dan membina kader, tetapi juga mengembangkan berbagai institusi yang memberikan manfaat luas bagi masyarakat. Dengan jutaan anggota yang tersebar di berbagai wilayah, Muhammadiyah dinilai telah menunjukkan kontribusi nyata dalam meningkatkan kesejahteraan masyarakat serta memperkuat kerja-kerja kemanusiaan.

“Semoga Allah senantiasa membantu, dan semoga Allah memudahkan pekerjaan kita, insyaallah,” tuturnya.

Ucapan tersebut menjadi salah satu bentuk pengakuan atas kiprah panjang Muhammadiyah dalam membangun kehidupan masyarakat yang berkemajuan. Memasuki usia ke-114 tahun, Muhammadiyah diharapkan terus memperluas kontribusinya, bukan hanya untuk bangsa Indonesia, lebih jauh juga bagi masyarakat dunia melalui dakwah, pendidikan, dan gerakan kemanusiaan. (Bhisma)

Dubes Türkiye: Muhammadiyah Bawa Perubahan Besar bagi Masyarakat Selama Lebih dari Satu Abad

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID, YOGYAKARTA – Duta Besar Republik Rakyat Tiongkok untuk Republik Indonesia, Wang Lutong, mengapresiasi kiprah Muhammadiyah yang selama lebih dari satu abad konsisten berkontribusi dalam membangun bangsa melalui berbagai bidang pengabdian.

Menurut Wang, Muhammadiyah telah bekerja keras mendorong kemajuan Indonesia, terutama melalui bidang pendidikan, kesehatan, kegiatan amal, hingga peningkatan kesejahteraan masyarakat. Komitmen jangka panjang tersebut dinilai turut mendorong kemajuan sosial, menumbuhkan kasih sayang, serta memperkuat solidaritas di tengah kehidupan masyarakat.

Atas kontribusi tersebut, Wang menilai gerakan Muhammadiyah layak memperoleh apresiasi setinggi-tingginya dari berbagai pihak.

“Tiongkok dan Indonesia adalah tetangga yang baik dan mitra yang erat. People to people exchanges, termasuk pertukaran agama dan budaya, memainkan peran penting dalam memperkuat saling pengertian (mutual understanding) dan persahabatan antara kedua negara,” ujarnya dalam rilis ucapan Milad Muhammadiyah yang diterima pada Jumat (13/11).

Lebih lanjut, Kedutaan Besar Republik Rakyat Tiongkok berharap Muhammadiyah dapat terus berkembang dan meraih keberhasilan dalam menjalankan berbagai misi pengabdiannya. Muhammadiyah juga diharapkan senantiasa menghadirkan kontribusi nyata serta memperluas sinergi yang berkemajuan demi kemaslahatan masyarakat luas.

MUHAMMADIYAH.OR.ID, PALU – Presiden Republik Indonesia, Prabowo Subianto, mengungkapkan bahwa dirinya turut memiliki tanggung jawab untuk menyukseskan Muktamar ke-49 Muhammadiyah.

Hal itu disampaikannya dengan nada jenaka saat memberikan sambutan dalam Pembukaan Tanwir dan Milad ke-114 Muhammadiyah di Universitas Muhammadiyah Palu, Kota Palu, Sulawesi Tengah, Sabtu (14/11).

Momen tersebut bermula ketika Prabowo mengingatkan bahwa dirinya telah memiliki Kartu Tanda Anggota (KTA) Muhammadiyah. Ia pun menyampaikan terima kasih atas pengingat tersebut sebelum mengaitkannya dengan tanggung jawab sebagai bagian dari persyarikatan.

“Terima kasih atas peringatan bahwa saya sudah punya kartu anggota Muhammadiyah,” ujar Prabowo.

Dengan nada ringan, Prabowo kemudian menyebut bahwa statusnya sebagai anggota Muhammadiyah membuat dirinya turut bertanggung jawab terhadap kesuksesan Muktamar ke-49 mendatang.

“Berarti sebagai anggota Muhammadiyah ikut bertanggung jawab atas suksesnya Muktamar ke-49,” ungkapnya yang disambut antusias peserta.

Suasana semakin hangat ketika Prabowo kembali menegaskan identitasnya sebagai anggota Muhammadiyah, meskipun saat ini mengemban amanah sebagai Presiden Republik Indonesia.

“Siap melaksanakan tugas ini jenderal bintang empat, presiden Indonesia, tapi anggota Muhammadiyah,” tuturnya.

Pernyataan tersebut menjadi salah satu momen menarik dalam sambutan Prabowo di hadapan keluarga besar Muhammadiyah yang hadir dari berbagai daerah di Indonesia dalam Pembukaan Tanwir dan Milad ke 114 Muhammadiyah di Palu, Sulawesi Tengah. (Taufik)

Synology’s NAS software combines file storage, photo management and backups in one system. Open source projects can replace many of those functions on compatible hardware, but setup and integration often require more work. No open source replacement with the same range of capabilities as Active Backup for Business has been identified, according to SpaceRex.

Compare storage management options for selecting an operating system and setting up shares on your own hardware. The feature also examines file syncing and photo libraries, including the account and permission differences that affect how applications work together. Finally, consider application backup consistency and the need to coordinate database dumps with stored files when planning a restore.

TrueNAS SCALE now officially branded as TrueNAS Community Edition is probably DSM’s strongest open source competitor, offering ZFS-based storage and many core NAS functions. DSM was found to be more user-friendly; OpenMediaVault was found to be powerful and simpler to deploy than TrueNAS. Nextcloud offers file syncing and collaboration, but felt somewhat slow and buggy, and its users and permissions do not automatically sync with TrueNAS. Immich proved faster than Synology Photos and avoids its HEIC limitations, but lacks integration with Synology Drive. Active Backup for Business backs up computers and servers without a license fee, while Synology’s backup offerings also protect Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. SpaceRex knows of no open source alternative that matches this breadth. rclone supports more connections than Synology Drive, but was found less user-friendly than Cloud Sync. motionEye is probably the best-known open source surveillance alternative, though notifications and camera compatibility can need more attention. Hyper Backup handles both files and application backup consistency. SpaceRex is unsure whether one alternative can reproduce everything it handles; replacing it requires accounting for each application’s files and databases.

DSM runs a Synology NAS’s core functions, from storage management to user accounts and networking. Synology is the NAS market leader because of its software and applications, rather than its hardware or prices.

TrueNAS SCALE is probably DSM’s strongest open source competitor. It offers ZFS-based storage and many of the same core functions: you can manage pools, users and networking; create SMB and NFS shares and iSCSI blocks; and set up scrub tasks and email notifications. It is also probably the default choice for advanced users building on their own hardware.

DSM was found to be more user-friendly, particularly when adding users, setting permissions and navigating the system. TrueNAS also permits some damaging mistakes that Synology would prevent. For example, restoring a snapshot to the wrong location can wipe data. Its reporting gives a less convenient view of system metrics than Synology’s resource manager.

On user-selected hardware, TrueNAS cannot identify the exact slot of a failing drive as DSM can on Synology hardware. TrueNAS Enterprise does offer that visibility, though it was found to be expensive. TrueNAS is also moving away from a strictly open source license. The change has caused community controversy but is not expected to affect users greatly.

OpenMediaVault is another option. It was found to be powerful and simpler to deploy than TrueNAS. Open source operating systems can run on a wide choice of hardware, including x86 machines or ARM systems where the software is compatible. XPEnology aims to reproduce Synology functionality using its source code, but it was not found to be a good option because of its issues and the availability of easier alternatives.

Synology Drive and Synology Office turn NAS storage into a shared document and file platform. They support public sharing, Synology Docs and local syncing on Mac, Windows and Linux. On Mac and Windows, on-demand sync shows files without keeping every file locally; a file downloads when you open it.

Nextcloud is a fully open source competitor with document editing, Markdown files, collaboration, external sharing and on-demand sync on macOS and Windows. Its application ecosystem also includes Nextcloud Talk and a calendar. Those additional applications appeared better developed than Synology’s calendar equivalent, but Nextcloud felt somewhat slow and buggy. Those issues have kept it from becoming the primary office file server in use.

There are integration differences when Nextcloud runs alongside TrueNAS. An SMB edit appears immediately in Synology Drive, while a file changed on a TrueNAS server needs a sync before Nextcloud recognizes it, although there are ways around that. DSM accounts and permissions carry across its applications; TrueNAS users and permissions do not automatically sync to Nextcloud. That gap is not an issue if your deployment lives entirely within Nextcloud’s own applications.

Synology Photos combines mobile backup, sharing and AI features. A shared family library has been used for about five years, including older family photographs that relatives can search by face.

Immich is a close alternative with mobile phone backup. It proved faster than Synology Photos and does not have Synology’s HEIC limitations. It has its own users and photo storage, however, so you lose the integration between Synology Photos and Synology Drive. Nextcloud Photos provides another option if you have less demanding photo needs.

Browse through more resources below from our in-depth content covering more areas on open source NAS alternatives.

Active Backup for Business can back up Windows servers and computers, macOS computers and Linux servers to a Synology without a license fee. It offers bare-metal restore, which can rebuild a drive as it was, and global file deduplication. Synology’s backup offerings can also protect MS365 and Google Workspace data with restore options.

If your business uses cloud storage, one Synology box can therefore collect computer, server and cloud backups at a fixed cost. That combination was found to be a major reason to deploy a NAS, and no other open source option has been found that does the same job.

Time Machine can cover this kind of backup in a Mac-only environment, but it cannot back up servers or MS365 and Google Workspace. That leaves a gap if you want the same breadth of protection with an entirely open source replacement.

Synology Cloud Sync supports download-only, upload-only and two-way transfers with cloud services. You can manage schedules and priorities in one place and, for example, keep a company’s Dropbox data locally or send local data to the cloud.

rclone is the open source project that Cloud Sync uses in the background. It supports a larger range of connections than Synology Drive, including storage systems Synology has not added. Some integrations no longer work, however, and iCloud Drive works inconsistently. rclone is mainly command-line driven; its new web interface is expected to help, although it was found to be less user-friendly than Cloud Sync.

For cameras, Surveillance Station records to a Synology NAS. UniFi generally came across as the better choice, except for a setup with one camera, but UniFi is not open source in the sense discussed here.

motionEye is probably the best-known open source surveillance alternative. You can use it as a set-and-forget system without pursuing its more complex features, though notifications and camera compatibility can need more attention. For larger camera deployments, dedicated applications or boxes looked preferable: constant recording on a NAS can affect the rest of the storage pool’s performance.

Hyper Backup protects folders and Synology packages to destinations including another NAS, a USB drive, cloud services, an S3 bucket or a server using rsync or WebDAV. Its advantage goes beyond copying files: it also handles application backup consistency and matches the file system to the database dump time.

That matters for an application such as Nextcloud, which has a database as well as files. A file-system copy of a database may restore corrupt if changes had not been written to disk during the backup. It is unclear whether any single alternative fully matches Hyper Backup across the applications it protects.

On Btrfs systems, Hyper Backup takes a snapshot at the start and sends files as they were at that point. By contrast, rsync copies files individually, so changes during a backup can leave an inconsistent state. TrueNAS offers snapshot replication, and replication is also an option with ZFS or Btrfs.

Database dump tools for PostgreSQL, MariaDB and MySQL can create consistent database files, but you must account for them alongside application files. Hourly PostgreSQL and MariaDB dumps required separate setup, and a restore would require matching them to the file-system backup time.

SpaceRex thinks home users who are comfortable tinkering and do not have a massive number of users can replace much of their Synology setup with open source software. For those relying on Active Backup for Business, he knows of no open source alternative. He is also unsure whether one tool can reproduce everything Hyper Backup handles; replacing it means accounting for each application’s files and databases.

Less familiar Excel functions can handle everyday spreadsheet tasks that might otherwise require manual checks or extra calculations. CONVERT, for example, changes 174 miles to about 280 kilometers using the unit codes “mi” and “km”; those codes are case sensitive. The example comes from a freight worksheet demonstrated by My Online Training Hub.

Use FORMULATEXT and TYPE to identify overwritten formulas and numbers stored as text, then examine how CELL and SHEET can keep workbook details current. The guide also shows how DATEDIF calculates complete years and remaining months between dates, including the need to place the earlier date first and avoid the unreliable MD unit.

CONVERT changes measurements between units and can fill an entire table column automatically. Unit codes are case sensitive, and CONVERT does not handle currency. FORMULATEXT can expose hard-coded values in place of formulas; IFNA and conditional formatting can flag them. TYPE identifies numbers stored as text, which can otherwise be missed by calculations such as SUBTOTAL. CELL, TEXTAFTER, SHEET and SHEETS can keep workbook and sheet details current in headers. N can add a note inside a numeric formula without changing its result. ROMAN and ARABIC convert numbers to and from Roman numerals. TRANSLATE and DETECTLANGUAGE help with languages; TRANSLATE requires Microsoft 365 and an internet connection, and its wording should be checked. DATEDIF calculates time between dates, including complete years and remaining months. Microsoft warns that its MD unit can produce negative, zero or inaccurate results for some date combinations.

CONVERT changes measurements between units, such as miles and kilometers or Fahrenheit and Celsius. In Excel, you can use it in a table to convert an entire column automatically.

On the route sheet of Harbor Lane Logistics, a practice freight business in Portland, a formula converts 174 miles to 280 kilometers for a new Canadian customer. It takes the distance as its number, “mi” as the from-unit and “km” as the to-unit. Excel copies the formula down the table automatically.

A second table references values and unit codes in columns K and L to convert pallet weight, warehouse temperature, fuel, transit time and container length. You can change the units in their cells, but unit codes are case sensitive: a lowercase “c” or a misspelled code produces an N/A error.

Excel’s IntelliSense displays a complete list of CONVERT units, although the unordered list can be tricky to search. CONVERT does not handle currency; Excel puts currency conversions in the currencies data type on the Data tab.

FORMULATEXT displays a cell’s underlying formula as text, helping you spot an overwritten calculation. Because it can return only a formula, it produces an N/A error in Harbor Lane’s third-quarter report where someone typed 5% into cell D10. The figure matches the expected result, but is likely to be wrong when actuals change the following month, without a warning.

Wrapping FORMULATEXT in IFNA replaces the error with “hard coded.” You can then use conditional formatting to mark cells containing that text with a light red fill and dark red text.

TYPE helps you find values that look numeric but are stored as text. In September orders copied from an ordering system, SUBTOTAL reports 19,565 instead of 32,705 because it ignores three text amounts. TYPE returns 2 for those entries in rows 8, 11 and 13. After you convert them to numbers, every TYPE result is 1 and the total is correct.

TYPE also returns 4 for a logical value, 16 for an error, 64 for an array and 128 for compound data. ISNUMBER instead returns TRUE for numbers and FALSE otherwise, so TYPE gives you more detail when examining an unfamiliar file from another system.

If warning flags are missing, check that background error checking is on under Error Checking in the Formulas options, then use Reset Ignored Errors if needed. A flagged cell offers an option to convert its contents to a number.

Expand your understanding of Excel functions and tips with additional resources from our extensive library of articles.

CELL can return a workbook’s path using any cell on the sheet as a reference. The result includes the file name in square brackets and the sheet name at the end. This can help you keep headers current: Harbor Lane’s manually typed report headers contain a file path, sheet name and sheet position, but could be out of date within a week.

TEXTAFTER extracts the sheet name using the first closing bracket as its delimiter. Outside Microsoft 365, you can instead use MID and FIND to locate that bracket and return the following characters.

SHEET and SHEETS provide the current sheet’s position and the workbook’s sheet count. In the example, a header changes from “sheet four of eight” to “sheet five of nine” after a sheet is added and the current one is moved. SHEET can also take a tab name: the “type” sheet is third in the example.

The N function lets you put a note inside a formula. Harbor Lane’s example records that its 4% commission rate was agreed with finance in August and is due for review in January. N turns the quoted note into zero, leaving the calculation unchanged. The note is limited to 255 characters, and the technique is really suitable only for formulas that return a number.

Keeping the note inside the formula makes it less likely to become separated from the calculation than a cell comment or note. N can also convert dates to serial numbers and TRUE to 1.

ROMAN and ARABIC convert numbers in opposite directions. ROMAN turns 14 into XIV for a document cover and handles values up to 3999. ARABIC converts scanned contract clause numbers back into numbers, so you can sort the example list by that column.

BAHTTEXT has written numbers as Thai words for more than 20 years. Combined with TRANSLATE, it can turn those words into another supported language. In the invoice example, the language codes TH and EN produce English text, although the result still contains Baht and Satang.

Two nested SUBSTITUTE calls replace those terms with dollars and cents, without VBA. TRANSLATE requires Microsoft 365 and an internet connection, and you should check its machine-translated wording before use.

TRANSLATE also converts product descriptions from English to Spanish for a customer in Mexico, with the same Microsoft 365, internet and machine-translation conditions. DETECTLANGUAGE can identify the language of text in a supplier spreadsheet when it is unknown.

DATEDIF calculates the time between dates, even though Excel offers no autocomplete or tooltip for it and does not show it in the function wizard or insert function dialogue. Excel retains the function for compatibility with Lotus 1-2-3 workbooks.

In the HR example, start dates are in column D and the report date is in F4. The Y unit returns complete years; YM returns the remaining months; and YD returns days left after complete years. MD returns days left after months, but Microsoft warns it can produce a negative number, zero or an inaccurate result for some date combinations.

Combining Y and YM with text gives a years-and-months figure for service, ages, contract lengths or overdue invoices. The start date must come before the end date, or DATEDIF returns an error. For the days calculation, My Online Training Hub would avoid MD given Microsoft’s warning about its results for some date combinations.

Explore how shared Steam Deck verification and SteamOS support can make the machine a practical target for developers. In GDC’s survey of more than 2,600 developers, 21% targeted Steam Machine for current or upcoming projects, compared with 10% for the next PlayStation and 8% for Project Helix. The video below from Stephen Robles gives us more details.

Front Camera Face Unlock: Introduces optical face authentication for quick unlocking, though Touch ID remains strictly required for sensitive actions like Apple Pay. Proximity “Close to Lock”: Automatically secures the device the moment you fold the iPhone Duo chassis shut. Contextual Siri AI: Upgrades the virtual assistant to parse and summarize entire web pages dynamically in real time. Ecosystem Centralization: Merges video podcasts directly into the native Apple TV app interface.

One of the most notable features in iOS 27.3 is Face Unlock, which uses the front camera to authenticate users. This feature allows you to unlock your device simply by looking at it, offering a seamless and efficient alternative to traditional unlocking methods. Setting up Face Unlock is straightforward, requiring only a few steps to calibrate the system to your facial profile. Once configured, it provides a quick and intuitive way to access your device.

However, there are some constraints to consider. Face Unlock performs best in well-lit environments, as low-light conditions can reduce its reliability. Additionally, the feature is limited to the front-facing camera, with no support for the inner display camera. For sensitive actions such as Apple Pay transactions or accessing iCloud passwords, Touch ID remains mandatory, making sure a dual-layered security approach. While this enhances overall protection, it may feel restrictive for users seeking a fully integrated biometric solution.

The “close to lock” feature introduces a proximity-based locking mechanism for the iPhone Duo. When enabled, your device automatically locks as soon as you close it, eliminating the need for manual input. This feature is particularly useful for users who prioritize efficiency and simplicity in securing their devices. It can be easily toggled on or off in the settings menu, allowing you to customize its behavior to suit your preferences.

Despite its convenience, some users may find “close to lock” less adaptable compared to custom shortcuts or automation tools. For those who rely on specific workflows, the default behavior might not align perfectly with their needs. However, for users who value a straightforward and intuitive solution, this feature offers a practical way to enhance device security without additional effort.

Siri receives a significant upgrade in iOS 27.3, making it more intelligent and versatile than ever before. One of the most impactful enhancements is Siri’s ability to analyze and interact with entire web pages, even when parts of the content are not visible on your screen. This capability is particularly useful for summarizing lengthy articles or extracting specific details from complex web pages.

For example, if you’re conducting research or browsing for information, Siri can now provide concise summaries or highlight key points without requiring you to scroll through the entire page. This improvement not only saves time but also positions Siri as a proactive and capable assistant for a wide range of tasks. Whether you’re a casual user or someone with more technical needs, Siri’s enhanced AI capabilities offer practical benefits that streamline everyday interactions.

The integration of video podcasts into the Apple TV app marks another exciting development in iOS 27.3. This feature aims to centralize your podcast experience by combining audio and video content within a single platform. While still in development and not fully functional in the current beta, this addition reflects Apple’s intent to expand the Apple TV app’s capabilities and appeal.

For users, this integration simplifies access to video podcasts, creating a more streamlined and cohesive experience. For podcasters, it provides a new avenue to reach audiences, potentially increasing visibility and engagement. By consolidating video podcasts into its ecosystem, Apple continues to refine its platform for both content creators and consumers, further enhancing the versatility of the Apple TV app.

The iOS 27.3 developer beta 2 release introduces these features as part of Apple’s ongoing efforts to enhance the iPhone Duo’s functionality. While features like Face Unlock and “close to lock” are already operational, others, such as video podcast support, remain in development. As with any beta release, users should anticipate potential limitations and adjustments in future updates. These iterative improvements reflect Apple’s commitment to delivering a polished and user-friendly experience.

The iOS 27.3 update brings meaningful enhancements that balance convenience, security, and functionality. Whether you’re unlocking your phone with a glance, securing it with proximity-based locking, or using Siri’s improved AI capabilities, these features demonstrate Apple’s dedication to optimizing the user experience. While some limitations persist, the update highlights Apple’s focus on refining its ecosystem to meet the evolving needs of its users.

Compare prescription costs and return policies across Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, including how insurance and lens upgrades can change the final price. Samsung and Google’s first smart glasses start at $395, less than the Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3, while matching its camera resolution and battery-life claim. For the right first-time buyer, particularly someone who needs prescription lenses, Samsung looks like the better deal on paper.

That comparison rests on specifications: Samsung’s glasses do not ship until December 10. The Meta comparison draws on experience wearing the Gen 2 and Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3, which was bought last month.

Both designs place cameras, microphones and speakers in the frames, without a lens display. You can take photos and video, play music, handle calls and connect to an AI assistant. Samsung makes the hardware, Google supplies the software, and Warby Parker and Gentle Monster provide the frames.

Warby Parker frames start at $395, or $54 less than the starting price of the Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3. Meta still sells the Gen 2 for $379, as well as glasses without the Ray-Ban name. After wearing both generations, the Gen 2 was found to do almost everything the Gen 3 does.

In one breakdown, a Warby Parker single-vision pair costs almost $180 less than a prescription Gen 3 priced at $674. Warby Parker lists progressive lenses at $725; a single-vision pair with every lens upgrade reaches $780.

Warby Parker accepts vision insurance, FSA and HSA funds for prescription pairs and claims an average saving of about $100. Gentle Monster adds about $100 for prescription lenses and is out of network for insurance. Its range goes to minus 9, compared with minus 8 at Warby Parker and minus 12 for Meta.

The Gen 3 weighs about 51 g and put pressure above the ears in testing. Lighter frames could matter, though how Samsung’s feel cannot be judged until they are tried. Sweat and light rain are fine for Samsung’s IPX4-rated pair; a pool probably is not.

Meta also claims up to nine hours on the glasses, with its case adding 50 hours, making battery life essentially even on paper. Meta AI received an upgrade this year and runs on the newer Muse Spark model in the US and Canada. After months of asking it about things in view, translating and sending messages by voice, it was found to work for everyday needs.

Samsung’s glasses use Google Gemini, connected to Google apps. Google says Gemini can look at an event poster, check your calendar and say whether you are free. Google lists live translation in more than 70 languages, versus Meta’s 20. Gemini appears intended to act within the phone, rather than primarily answer questions, but it remains a demo on these glasses until they ship. One buyer said he canceled a $1,000 order because his OnePlus phone was unsupported.

Some Samsung features work only on Android at launch, including guided vision, which describes the surroundings for blind and low-vision users. Samsung’s temples do not adjust, so you choose a size; an optician can adjust Gen 3 temple tips. Gentle Monster prescription orders cannot be returned, including the glasses. Warby Parker offers 30-day returns and a one-year warranty. Google says demos are available in more than 360 Warby Parker stores. Samsung reached $395 by cutting two microphones, adjustable fit and access for most of the world.

At the time of recording, Gentle Monster preorders were sold out, with notification sign-ups available. Warby Parker orders begin shipping in mid-December, and prescription pairs can take up to 21 days once in production. Tech with Spencer is not preordering yet: he tries glasses on first for every review.

Both pairs have a recording light and a physical off switch. Samsung says its camera will not record if the light is covered. But 9to5Google reports that the light comes on only when a photo or video is saved and stays off while Gemini looks through the camera. Google says nearby faces are hidden before Gemini sees them and camera material sent to Gemini is not used to train its AI or target ads.

He wants more real-world time before trusting either company’s privacy claims. A required Gen 3 security update arrived during the review without making clear exactly what it fixed.

Tech with Spencer thinks Samsung is the better deal on paper for a first-time buyer with a Galaxy or Pixel, especially with a prescription, but advises trying the glasses on first. For existing Gen 2 or Gen 3 owners, he would not switch now: that would mean spending about $400 on an AI upgrade nobody has lived with yet. He leans toward Meta for iPhone owners because Samsung loses features at launch. Neither pair is for someone who wants a lens display.

The Samsung Galaxy Buds Pro bring a distinctive approach to the wireless earbud market with their open-ear, clip-on design. These earbuds cater to users who seek a balance between situational awareness and high-quality audio performance. Unlike traditional in-ear models, the Galaxy Buds Pro emphasize comfort and environmental awareness, positioning themselves as a unique option in the competitive audio landscape. The video below from Sakitech gives us a look at these new headphones.

Open-Ear Clip Architecture: Features an ergonomic clip-on design that rests outside the ear canal, preserving natural ambient sound awareness. Twin Boost Drivers: Equipped with custom 11.3mm acoustic drivers engineered to deliver rich, balanced sound without physical ear canal sealing. Smart Motion Controls: Integrates experimental head gesture recognition—allowing users to nod or shake their head to manage calls hands-free. Endurance Power Cell: Delivers an impressive combined battery lifespan of up to 38 hours utilizing the compact wireless charging case.

The open-ear, clip-on design of the Galaxy Buds Pro ensures a secure and comfortable fit, making them an excellent choice for users who find in-ear earbuds uncomfortable or isolating. This design allows ambient sound to pass through naturally, making these earbuds particularly suitable for outdoor activities such as running, cycling, or commuting, where staying aware of your surroundings is essential.

The earbuds feature a touch-sensitive surface, allowing intuitive control over media playback, volume adjustments and call management. This user-friendly interface ensures that you can seamlessly interact with your device without interrupting your activities. The thoughtful design prioritizes both functionality and ease of use, enhancing the overall listening experience.

The Galaxy Buds Pro are designed for open listening, which means they do not include active noise cancellation (ANC). However, they compensate with a range of innovative features that enhance usability. Customizable touch-and-hold gestures and head gesture recognition add a layer of convenience, allowing you to nod to accept calls or shake your head to decline them. These features streamline everyday interactions and make the earbuds more intuitive to use.

The inclusion of 360 audio technology and a built-in equalizer ensures an immersive sound experience. Additionally, the experimental auto volume adjustment feature adapts audio output based on ambient noise levels, maintaining consistent sound quality across different environments. These features demonstrate Samsung’s focus on delivering practical and user-centric innovations.

Equipped with an 11.3 mm twin boost speaker, the Galaxy Buds Pro deliver rich and dynamic audio that exceeds expectations for an open-ear design. While they may not replicate the deep bass of sealed earbuds, the sound profile is well-balanced, offering clarity and depth that will satisfy most listeners.

For calls, the earbuds use machine learning-based noise reduction to ensure your voice remains clear, even in noisy surroundings. This makes the Galaxy Buds Pro a reliable choice for both music enthusiasts and professionals who require dependable call quality for work or personal use.

The Galaxy Buds Pro excel in battery performance, offering up to 38 hours of music playback or 25 hours of talk time when combined with the charging case. The earbuds themselves provide several hours of continuous use, while the case ensures you can recharge on the go. This extended battery life makes the Galaxy Buds Pro a practical option for users with demanding schedules, eliminating the need for frequent recharging.

With an IP54 water resistance rating, the Galaxy Buds Pro are designed to withstand light rain and sweat, making them suitable for workouts and outdoor use. However, it is important to note that the charging case does not share this water resistance rating. To ensure the longevity of your earbuds, it is advisable to keep the case protected from moisture.

The Galaxy Buds Pro integrate seamlessly with Samsung Galaxy devices, offering a smooth and straightforward setup process. The companion app provides a range of customization options, allowing you to adjust sound profiles, configure gesture controls and fine-tune other settings to suit your preferences. While the earbuds are optimized for Samsung users, they are also compatible with other devices, making sure versatility for a broader audience.

The Galaxy Buds Pro are ideal for individuals who prioritize comfort and situational awareness over complete sound isolation. Whether you are an active user seeking secure and comfortable earbuds for exercise or someone who values premium sound quality without the plugged-in feel, these earbuds cater to a wide range of needs. Their innovative features, thoughtful design and reliable performance make them a compelling choice in the growing market of open-ear wireless earbuds.

The Samsung Galaxy Buds Pro redefine what open-ear wireless earbuds can offer, combining innovative features with a design that prioritizes comfort and awareness. Whether you are navigating a bustling city or enjoying an outdoor workout, these earbuds deliver a reliable and enjoyable listening experience tailored to modern lifestyles.

XREAL Aura pairs lightweight glasses with a separate Android XR computer, using optical passthrough to place virtual content over a direct view of the surroundings. The system launched at $1,099, with a phone-sized compute puck handling processing rather than a standard phone. Early use showed responsive hand gestures and stable virtual objects as the wearer moved, according to MRTV.

Explore how hand tracking and the puck’s touchpad offer different ways to navigate, and how USB-C connections can link the glasses to compatible devices. The breakdown also examines fit and field-of-view limits, including why immersive VR apps may feel more restrictive than mixed-reality use, so you can judge which experiences suit the hardware.

XREAL Aura pairs lightweight glasses with a separate Android XR compute puck for a launch price of $1,099. MRTV says the price will rise by $200, though the timing is unclear. Optical passthrough lets wearers see their surroundings directly with virtual objects overlaid. In MRTV’s first session, the image looked sharp and the blend of physical and virtual views felt convincing. Hand tracking responded well to aiming and pinching, while six-degrees-of-freedom tracking kept virtual objects steady as the wearer moved. The puck’s touchpad also worked well as a controller. The restricted field of view felt natural in mixed reality but was more apparent in VR apps that black out the surroundings. MRTV prefers a VR headset for highly immersive experiences. The battery indication fell only a little during an hour of use. Battery life seemed quite good, but needs a long-term test.

XREAL Aura combines lightweight glasses with a separate Android XR computer for a launch price of $1,099. In an initial session, hand tracking responded well to aiming and pinching. Virtual objects also stayed fixed as the wearer looked around and moved closer.

MRTV’s first impressions were highly positive, particularly for how the glasses combine virtual objects with a direct view of the surroundings. MRTV calls Aura a huge deal that may help bring the technology further into the mainstream.

XREAL’s first Android XR headset uses a phone-sized compute unit rather than a phone. MRTV says the price will rise by $200, in a remark tied to the end of the year, though the timing of the increase is unclear.

The aluminum compute puck runs Android XR and has a touchpad where a phone screen would sit. You can control the system with the touchpad or hand gestures. An aluminum-accented clip attaches the puck to trousers or other objects.

The puck is light for its size and has a premium feel. Its power port accepts DisplayPort input, so you can connect a Steam Deck, MacBook or another device with USB-C video output. You can also connect the glasses directly to a USB-C video-out device, including a Steam Deck or MacBook Air.

Asked why a standard Android phone could not house the computer, XREAL’s team told MRTV that the puck is more powerful and dissipates heat better than a Samsung Galaxy Fold 8. That is why a phone cannot house the computing hardware right now.

Here are more detailed guides and articles that you may find helpful on XREAL Aura glasses.

The glasses use prism lenses like those in the XREAL One series. Their outward-facing cameras handle hand tracking and six degrees of freedom tracking rather than recording people nearby. A separate camera lets AI and Gemini see what you see, and a flashing LED indicates when it records.

You can angle each stem independently, an adjustment recommended for the best visuals. The fitted nose pad places your eyes closer to the lenses, but you can swap it for more standard pads that position your eyes farther away. XREAL changed the nose pads for Aura. Buttons select headset modes and adjust volume or brightness, while speakers sit close to your ears.

Given the limited room for speakers, the audio is not expected to be better than that of other glasses of this kind. A USB-C port connects the glasses to the puck or another device. The angled end of the supplied cable goes into the glasses, and the other end connects to the bottom of the puck.

Small holes hold a lens insert that you can take to an optician for personal lenses. XREAL also sells inserts, for what MRTV believes is $69. Inserts from XREAL One Series headsets fitted and worked, so new ones were not needed for Aura.

The included case holds the computer at the top and the glasses at the bottom. It has a separate cable compartment, a microfiber cloth and a lock to keep it closed during storage. It holds everything needed for spatial computing. The box also contains a quick-start guide, a charging cable, nose pads and the insert for glasses wearers.

The case is sturdy, well made and thoughtfully arranged. It is much smaller than the Apple Vision Pro case, for which MRTV paid more than $200. Aura itself is also much smaller and cheaper than Apple’s headset.

The Aura glasses will feel familiar to anyone who has used the XREAL One Pro Plus. During first setup, display alignment involved placing a finger inside a virtual object as it moved closer. Seeing XR features familiar from Vision Pro in glasses this small made a strong impression.

Aura uses optical passthrough: you see your surroundings directly through the glasses, with virtual elements laid over them. That differs from the video passthrough used by Apple Vision Pro and Meta devices. XREAL tried real-photon AR when the company was called Nreal, but that effort came too early.

Because the view of the room is direct, it has the full resolution of the wearer’s own eyes. MRTV says it is the first time this real-photon approach to AR has worked so well.

In the first session, a virtual menu appeared alongside the room, and virtual objects looked as though they were floating in front of the wearer. The image looked clear, with vibrant colors and perfect blacks, and the blend of physical and virtual views was particularly convincing. A panorama and immersive 3D content were also viewed.

Six degrees of freedom tracking kept virtual objects steady as the wearer turned or approached them. Hand tracking worked very well in the first impression: aiming and pinching produced a laser-like pointer. The puck also tracked well when used as a thumb-operated mouse pad.

The mixed-reality field of view is restricted, but it feels natural in Android XR because the glasses themselves appear to form the boundary. The view reached their edges and felt larger than on older XREAL devices.

That impression changes in VR apps, which black out the surrounding environment. There, the field of view is quite similar to XREAL One Pro Plus, and a VR headset remains preferable for especially immersive experiences.

Aura’s 1,900-by-1,200 resolution is not much higher than that of other XREAL devices and competitors in the same space, and is not far from the XREAL One Pro Plus. The image looks very sharp because the resolution is concentrated within a limited field of view. People who found the One Pro Plus resolution insufficient probably will not see a huge difference.

The battery indication fell only a little during an hour of use. The first impression is that battery life seems quite good, though it needs a long-term test.

MRTV says Aura works exceptionally well for watching content, working and using apps in mixed reality, with virtual objects held steady as the wearer moves. Battery life seems quite good after an hour, but still needs a long-term test. For highly immersive VR, MRTV prefers a VR headset: Aura’s limited field of view becomes more apparent when apps black out the surroundings.

AI-powered hacking tools are enabling attackers to automate and accelerate multi-stage intrusions, with some breaches reportedly occurring in under 15 minutes, according to Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) and Mandiant. Autonomous multi-agent frameworks like ARTEX, Cairn, CyberStrikeAI, and PentAGI are being used to coordinate complex cyberattacks, significantly reducing the time required to compromise systems. Artificial intelligence is reshaping the cybersecurity landscape, often to its detriment. AI-powered tools are allowing hackers to automate and accelerate their attacks, making it harder for traditional defenses to keep up. A report by Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) and Mandiant highlights how adversaries are using generative AI to compress attack timelines, scale operations, and execute multi-stage intrusions at machine speed. The implications are alarming.

A major development in cybercrime is the use of autonomous multi-agent frameworks. Tools like ARTEX, Cairn, CyberStrikeAI, and PentAGI enable hackers to coordinate complex attacks with notable efficiency. ARTEX acts as an autonomous hacking orchestration tool, while Cairn uses a feedback loop to adapt AI actions in real time. CyberStrikeAI combines language models with over 100 security tools, and PentAGI breaks penetration testing objectives into smaller tasks, delegating them to multiple agents.

These frameworks have significantly reduced the time required to compromise systems. In some cases, attackers using ARTEX activity have accessed accounts and systems in under 15 minutes, compared to the days or months such breaches once required. This speed and adaptability are reshaping the threat landscape, leaving IT teams with minimal response time.

GTIG has also noted a shift toward autonomous workflows and multi-agent frameworks in adversary tactics. Threat actors are automating exploitation pipelines against internet-facing servers, demonstrating the efficiency of AI-driven attacks.

The number of zero-day vulnerabilities, flaws exploited before a patch is available, has risen sharply. Between January and August 2025, vulnerabilities discovered and exploited increased steadily, from five to six in January to nearly 25 in June, peaking at 30 in August. In the past week alone, around 99 vulnerabilities were identified, including 14 in Copeland refrigerator controllers.

Over the last six months, zero-day vulnerabilities have surpassed end-day vulnerabilities in frequency. Attackers have exploited zero days to breach 21 management servers, installing crypto miners before patches were released. These servers, located in the US, South Africa, Canada, the UK, Germany, France, and Sweden, were compromised on the same day the vulnerabilities were exploited. This highlights how quickly zero-day flaws are being weaponized.

Threat actors are automating the reverse engineering of patches, enabling them to weaponize vulnerabilities faster than ever. This trend poses a serious challenge, as developers struggle to address vulnerabilities before exploitation occurs. The increasing frequency of zero-day incidents underscores the growing sophistication of cyberattacks, often driven by AI-powered tools.

AI’s role in cybercrime extends beyond hacking into areas like cyber espionage and information operations. Threat actors are using large language models (LLMs) for credential theft, cloud resource compromise, and reselling access to high-performance AI models through underground services like LLM mixers. Financially motivated attackers are profiting from stolen credentials and compromised cloud resources.

In cyber espionage, AI tools are automating data analysis, target research, and supply chain attack vectors. Attackers are manipulating autonomous coding assistance and configurations to deploy backdoors, creating new opportunities for exploitation.

In information operations, LLMs are generating synthetic media at scale, creating localized personas, and automating cross-platform content distribution. State-sponsored groups and commercial influence-as-a-service vendors are using these capabilities to manipulate public opinion and monetize inauthentic political networks.

The rapid development of AI-powered hacking tools is outpacing traditional cybersecurity measures. Many organizations have contributed to this vulnerability by deprioritizing security, resulting in weak security features and inadequate vulnerability testing. This has left more systems open to exploitation.

Threat actors are now targeting a broader range of devices, from Mac systems to smart appliances like refrigerators. Microsoft 365 phishing attempts and Teams meeting phishing are also on the rise, illustrating the diverse attack vectors being exploited.

Google claims to be addressing these challenges through a multi-pronged defense strategy, including proactive model-level safeguards, specialized threat intelligence, and targeted containment protocols. The company is also using its AI threat defense architecture to counter AI-driven attacks. GTIG employs an AI threat tracker to monitor agentic threat activity, improving its response to emerging threats.

Anthropic and OpenAI are also contributing by releasing cybersecurity AI frameworks designed to detect and prevent attacks. However, the scale and speed of AI-driven cybercrime remain a significant challenge for defenders.

The rise of AI-powered hacking marks a critical turning point in cybersecurity. Tools enabling automation, coordination, and unprecedented speed are lowering the barrier to entry for cybercriminals, making it easier to exploit vulnerabilities. The growing prevalence of zero-day incidents and increasingly sophisticated attacks highlight the urgent need for stronger defenses.

While companies like Google and OpenAI are developing AI frameworks to counter these threats, the scale and speed of AI-driven cybercrime pose a daunting challenge. For IT teams and administrators, staying ahead of thousands of coordinated AI agents is becoming increasingly difficult. SavvyNik concludes that cybersecurity must evolve rapidly to keep pace with these emerging threats or risk falling further behind.

Bloomberg Technoz, Jakarta - Kalimat bernada putus asa juga separuh meradai terlontar dari bibir Menteri Keuangan Suahasil Nazara saat memaparkan kinerja Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (APBN) 2026, Jumat (13/11/2026) lalu. Pernyataan ini akhirnya ramai menjadi perbincangan publik.

Berdasarkan data Kementerian Keuangan, sampai 31 Oktober 2026 penerimaan pajak baru terkumpul Rp1.796,8 triliun atau baru 76,12% dari target yang dipatok pemerintah sepanjang 2026. Artinya, pemerintah masih harus kejar setoran menghimpun pajak sebesar Rp514 triliun pada November dan Desember 2026.

Bloomberg Technoz, Jakarta - Bank Indonesia (BI) dijadwalkan menggelar pengumuman kebijakan suku bunga BI Rate hari ini (18/11/2026). Pengumuman ini akan menjadi perhatian pelaku pasar di tengah pelemahan rupiah sebesar 1,35% sejak keputusan suku bunga di Oktober.

Survei Bloomberg terhadap 38 ekonom dan analis hingga pagi ini menunjukkan, sebanyak 60% responden memperkirakan BI akan menahan suku bunga. Sementara, 40% lainnya memproyeksikan kenaikan 25 basis poin (bps) jadi 6%.

Tekanan terhadap rupiah dan meningkatnya ketidakpastian global mendorong sebagian ekonom dan analis memperkirakan BI perlu kembali menaikkan suku bunga.

Tapi, agaknya tekanan inflasi belum mendesak BI untuk kembali mengetatkan kebijakan moneter kali ini dan memberi ruang bagi BI untuk mempertahankan BI Rate di level 5,75%.

Inflasi Oktober tercatat 3,23% secara tahunan (year-on-year/yoy). Angka ini turun dari 3,28% pada September dan di bawah konsensus pasar yang sebesar 3,3%.

Laboratorium AI terkemuka, Anthropic dan OpenAI, juga telah berupaya mencari alternatif chip Nvidia.

Pejabat The Fed Tegaskan Tak Perlu Kenaikan Suku Bunga Agresif

Gubernur Federal Reserve Bank New York, John Williams. (Dok: Samuel Corum/Bloomberg)

Bloomberg, Gubernur Federal Reserve Bank of New York, John Williams, mengatakan bahwa bank sentral AS masih memiliki pekerjaan rumah untuk mengembalikan inflasi ke target 2%. Namun, ia menepis anggapan bahwa The Fed perlu mempertimbangkan kenaikan suku bunga secara besar-besaran.

"Saya tidak berpikir situasi saat ini membutuhkan langkah yang drastis," kata Williams pada Selasa dalam sebuah acara yang diselenggarakan oleh Axios di New York. Ia menambahkan bahwa pendekatan komite dalam meluangkan waktu untuk menganalisis data telah berjalan dengan baik.

"Pada pertemuan terakhir, kami mengatakan ingin mengumpulkan lebih banyak informasi," ujarnya.

"Saat ini, data memberikan gambaran yang cukup jelas — perekonomian sedang kuat dan semakin menguat, sementara inflasi masih bertahan tinggi. Kita perlu menurunkannya," katanya.

Bloomberg, Komisi Sekuritas dan Bursa Amerika Serikat (Securities and Exchange Commission/SEC) tengah menyelidiki Nvidia Corp., demikian dilaporkan Wall Street Journal pada Selasa. Penyelidikan ini berlangsung ketika perusahaan tersebut menghadapi dampak dari mundurnya mantan CEO Jensen Huang.

Belum diketahui secara pasti fokus penyelidikan SEC. Namun, surat kabar tersebut melaporkan, dengan mengutip sejumlah sumber yang mengetahui masalah ini, bahwa penyelidikan mencakup pemeriksaan apakah pengungkapan informasi yang dilakukan perusahaan telah menyesatkan investor.

Nvidia tidak menanggapi permintaan komentar terkait laporan tersebut. Sementara itu, SEC menolak memberikan komentar.

Sejumlah perselingkuhan Jensen Huang di luar pernikahan telah menjerumuskan Nvidia ke dalam krisis yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya. Situasi ini memicu aksi jual besar-besaran saham perusahaan dan berujung pada pencopotannya dari jabatan CEO.

Bloomberg, Aksi jual saham perusahaan-perusahaan teknologi raksasa menyeret pasar saham melemah di tengah meningkatnya kekhawatiran terhadap gangguan teknis. Investor juga mencermati laporan kinerja Nvidia Corp. untuk mendapatkan gambaran mengenai prospek kecerdasan buatan (AI).

Dalam perdagangan setelah jam bursa, produsen chip tersebut memberikan proyeksi pendapatan yang solid. Namun, serangkaian gangguan layanan teknologi membebani sentimen pasar pada Selasa. Kali ini, gangguan tersebut berdampak pada badan intelijen elektronik Amerika Serikat (NSA) dan layanan Apple Inc. Indeks S&P 500 merosot ke level terendah sejak Juli.

Seiring Nvidia merilis laporan kinerjanya, prospek jangka panjang perusahaan tersebut menjadi sorotan setelah Jensen Huang dicopot dari jabatannya. Huang menyatakan kesediaannya untuk kembali menjabat sebagai CEO. Namun, dewan direksi saat ini belum mempertimbangkan kemungkinan tersebut.

Nvidia memperkirakan pendapatan pada kuartal IV tahun fiskal mencapai US$130 miliar, dengan kisaran plus-minus 3%, menurut pernyataan perusahaan. Angka tersebut lebih tinggi dibandingkan dengan estimasi rata-rata analis sebesar US$125,3 miliar.

Indonesia’s Ministry of Forestry has emphasised the need to ensure that climate finance and forest carbon initiatives deliver tangible and equitable benefits to communities, particularly women, Indigenous Peoples, and vulnerable groups.

The message was delivered by Catur Endah Prasetiani, Director General of Social Forestry, during her closing remarks at a session titled “Who Benefits from Nature-based Solutions and Forest Carbon? Women and Communities in ASEAN’s Climate Finance.” The session took place at the ASEAN Pavilion during the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye, on Monday (16 November).

Trending UMM-NIU Sepakati Kerja Sama Pendidikan dan Riset untuk Pembangunan Berkelanjutan

In her remarks, Catur Endah stressed that the success of nature-based solutions (NbS) and forest carbon initiatives should not be measured solely by the amount of carbon sequestered or the volume of financing mobilised. Their success must also be reflected in biodiversity conservation, improved community well-being, and stronger livelihoods for those who protect and manage forests.

“One of the key messages from this discussion is that climate action and forest carbon initiatives must deliver tangible benefits to the communities that protect and manage forests. Their success should not be measured only by the amount of carbon sequestered or financing mobilised, but also by their contribution to biodiversity conservation and community well-being,” Catur Endah said.

According to Catur Endah, Indonesia’s experience with its Social Forestry programme demonstrates that communities can play a central role in sustainable forest management and climate action.

By securing access and forest management rights, strengthening local capacities and institutions, and developing forest-based enterprises, communities can improve their livelihoods while maintaining healthy and sustainable ecosystems.

Catur Endah also highlighted the importance of ensuring that women have equal opportunities to lead, participate in decision-making, and benefit from forest management.

She stressed that adopting a Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI) approach is essential to preventing forestry programmes and climate finance initiatives from excluding groups that have historically faced barriers to accessing resources and economic opportunities.

During the forum, the Ministry of Forestry outlined five priority actions: integrating Social Forestry and nature-based solutions into climate and conservation agendas; strengthening community management rights and participation; developing inclusive and transparent climate finance with equitable benefit-sharing; advancing women’s leadership and GEDSI implementation; and expanding international cooperation and knowledge exchange, particularly between ASEAN and African countries.

“Climate finance must be supported by credible governance, transparent mechanisms, and equitable benefit-sharing. Women, Indigenous Peoples, local communities, persons with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups must be able to participate meaningfully and benefit from climate action,” Catur Endah emphasised.

The dialogue at the ASEAN Pavilion brought together speakers from the Zambia Forestry Agency, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the International Tropical Timber Organization (ITTO), Parabukas, and Indonesia’s Ministry of Forestry.

Discussions explored the role of Social Forestry and nature-based solutions in supporting climate action, women’s leadership in forest management, GEDSI implementation, lessons from community-based forest carbon initiatives in Africa, and sustainable forest management practices across ASEAN.

Catur Endah said these lessons must be translated into concrete action through supportive policies, capacity building, improved access to finance, and stronger cooperation across sectors and countries.

She highlighted the need for collaboration among governments, civil society, financial institutions, businesses, and development partners to scale up successful practices and ensure that climate finance reaches communities directly involved in forest management.

“Protecting forests is not just about preserving carbon. It is also about empowering the communities that safeguard them and ensuring that the benefits of climate action reach those who need them most,” Catur Endah concluded.
